journey.name: contact import
journey.description:
Importing the follows of an adopted Pubky Ring identity saves every follow, including a follow that has never published a profile, which is imported under its truncated public key. While the import runs, Import All shows a spinner and Select is disabled, and leaving the screen does not stop the import. Contacts then lists every saved contact at once, without a screen-wide loading spinner, and fills in names as their profiles load.
Precondition (not a listed capability): Pubky Ring (package app.pubkyring) installed on the same device and signed with this repository's app/debug.keystore, as for the ring choice rows journey, with an identity that has a published profile and follows at least three keys, at least one of which has never published a profile. Also needed: an onboarded dev wallet with Paykit enabled (the default), PIN off and no active Pubky identity in Bitkit. The journey adopts that identity, so sign out of it in Bitkit before running the journey again.
On a fast network the import can finish before the buttons are checked, so the journey slows the emulator network with adb emu; a physical device needs another way to slow its connection. If the import still finishes first, report "already finished" for that step rather than failing. Contact rows carry testTag "Contact_" followed by the contact's public key.

actions.action: Tap the profile button (testTag "ProfileButton") on the home screen; if the profile intro (testTag "ProfileIntro") shows, tap Continue (testTag "ProfileIntro-button")
Tap the row (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentity") of the identity with follows and wait for the import overview, which shows how many friends were found
Note the number of friends shown
Run adb emu network delay gprs and adb emu network speed edge
Verify Import All shows a spinner and Select (testTag "ContactImportOverviewSelect") is disabled, then tap Select and verify the selection screen does not open
Wait up to two minutes for the import to finish and the next setup screen to open
Run adb emu network delay none and adb emu network speed full
Open the menu (testTag "HeaderMenu") and tap Contacts (testTag "DrawerContacts")

Verify the list shows one row (testTag "Contact_" followed by a public key) per noted friend with no screen-wide loading spinner, and the follow that never published a profile is listed under its truncated public key
